overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: approving minutes about one month after each meeting was timely, though approval at the next meeting is recommended.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Commission approved minutes of its January 21 and March 11 meetings too slowly, not at the next meeting.
allegations.key_passage: While we recommend that minutes be approved at a public body's next meeting, failure to do so does not automatically make approval of minutes untimely.
